liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Big Boy Pete** (3 reviews): Reviewer singles out this opener as a must-have track from the show; Novel but scattered; the band only starts humming at Brown Eyed Women [16][23][24]
- **Shakedown Street** (2 reviews): Reviewer found this Shakedown unbelievable; Jerry's solo is fast and built from deep, heavy-sounding notes [21][22]
- **Playing in the Band** (2 reviews): The jam heads in a spacey direction and takes on a life of its own; Jerry leads the band to interesting places, with a sweet transition into She Belongs to Me [19][25]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Reviewer calls this performance sloppy, part of an energetic but loose rest of the show [25]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Reviewer hears some great guitar licks in this Wharf Rat [23]
- **Walking The Dog** (1 review): Reviewer singles out this closer as a must-have track from the show [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **Big Boy Pete**: back after 552 archived shows (2561 days); rare: 11 archived performances [28]
- **She Belongs to Me**: rare: 10 archived performances [28]
- **Walking The Dog**: rare: 9 archived performances [28]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-11-21.134747.mtx.tobin.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 132 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd85-11-21.sbd.lai.3351.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 132 min; rated 4.38/5 by 21 [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboard source with vocals and guitars well balanced; First set seems to include audience patches; the second set sounds like a matrix mix; Recording has a unique presence, as if standing about 50 feet from the stage, with depth and ambience [24][26]
- **gd1985-11-21.134748.dts.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 132 min [3]
- **gd1985-11-21.135123.aud.bernstein.flac2448**: audience recording; 21 songs; 136 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: In Looks Like Rain the tape cuts in, with roughly ten seconds missing [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes a surprise opener and a surprise encore bookending the show [19]
- Reviewer stood by the speaker stack on Phil's side; nearby dancers moved in unison like a flock of birds [21]
- Reviewer says it falls outside their five best shows of fall 1985, with many short songs [16]
- Set one has fire but lacks the consistency of many other 1985 shows, a near-flawless year [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-11-21.134747.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid=105992) Recording Info:SBD -> Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550/Maxell XLIIS-90); Transfer Info:Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1)… [1]. Also: Matrix mix of two sources, about 52% soundboard and 48% audience; Both sources patched with audience audio from a video project; mixed by an archive.org user, FLAC conversion November 2015 [1]
- **gd85-11-21.sbd.lai.3351.sbefail.shnf**: source: dsdb> pcm> dat> cdr [2]. Also: Transfer chain: digital soundboard to PCM to DAT to CDR, via Mike Lai; Filler on the tape comes from a 10/13/68 show [2]
- **gd1985-11-21.134748.dts.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix ; SBD (shnid=105992) Recording Info:SBD -> Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550/Maxell XLIIS-90); Transfer Info:Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1)… [3]. Also: Both soundboard and audience sources patched with audience audio from a video project; FLAC conversion November 2015; This version is a DTS 5.1 surround release prepared for an audio CD [3]
- **gd1985-11-21.135123.aud.bernstein.flac2448**: taped by Jon Bernstein; transferred by Andrew F.; source: AUD: Unknown mics > Sony TC-D5 > Maxell MX-Metal 90's. Recording by Jon Bernstein. [4]. Also: Audience recording patched from another source for the crowd after Dire Wolf and for part of Drums [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1985-11-21 Henry J. Kaiser Convention Center, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1985-11-21-henry-j-kaiser-convention-center-oakland-ca-usa/) [29]
